issue: yugmé is AOR.1PL 'we yoked'; the subject is 3sg (he yoked the horses): needs yéwgt
h₁yód h₂wésm̥: AOR.1SG 'when I grew bright'; the English and context need 3sg h₂wést 'it dawned'
nókʷtm̥ h₂éwsosm̥-kʷe dedórḱe: PRF.3SG 'he has seen', but the speaker says 'I have seen': needs PRF.1SG dedórḱh₂e
h₃rḗǵs ph₂tréy wérh₁t: engine's DAT.SG of péh₂tōr 'guardian' is ph₂tréy, identical to ph₂tḗr 'father' DAT.SG; reads as 'said to the father' (engine declension of root-accented -tor agent noun)
dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰér séngʷt: aorist 'sank' rendered as general present 'It sinks under the earth'; a present would fit the explanation
spélom moy ḱlutā́m: ḱlutā́m is AOR/IMP.3DU 'let the two hear'; addressed to plural guests, 'Hear my tale!' needs 2pl imperative (ḱluté)
dyḗws h₁ésyeh₂ey sh₂wéns h₁imń̥bʰis woydéyet: the thing caused-to-be-seen is put in the instrumental plural ('with the courses of the sun'); English has it as direct object 'the course of the sun'
h₁éy-kʷe gʷʰréh₁yet: h₁éy is masc anaphoric (he/they) with 3sg verb; English 'it was warm' is impersonal - pronoun reference unclear
